Crossbow Overview
Crossbow
is a special combat sidebar skill that can be used together with 2 other 'main' skills.It requires you to be holding a crossbow in your Offhand. It offers decent damage with long cooldowns.
In-Game Description
Knowledge of crossbows including how to fire and reload them, as well as how to maintain them in peak condition.
Training Crossbow
Bellema Deftwhisper
will teach you at
Comfortable
favor level. She also unlocks levels 51-60 and teaches the various Crossbow abilities.
Floxie
unlocks levels 61-70 and levels 71-80.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Serendipity Cheddar
deep beneath
Povus
.

Related Skills
